intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Night. The student union hackathon hall is all LED strips, pizza boxes, and somebody yelling about a merge.

hello.speaker: javascript
hello.text: Hiii! New person! I'm Jay, you're coming to the hackathon, I already added you to the group chat. Do you like pizza? Too late, I ordered it.

teach.speaker: javascript
teach.text: Okay okay okay, rule one of hackathons: if you don't know what's happening, console.log it! Here, you try!

passed.speaker: javascript
passed.text: YES! You're officially a hacker now! Have a slice!

bye.speaker: javascript
bye.text: Totally fine! The hackathon goes all night anyway!
